schema.purpose: Hand-derived test cases for contract §3 metrics. pipeline/metrics.py (pytest) and web/src/lib/metrics.ts (vitest) must both reproduce every 'expected' block.
schema.case.horizon: Same fields as horizon/<id>.json (§2.2) minus meta/site_id/dem: az_step_deg, n, observer_heights_m, masks{'2': number[n], '10': number[n]}. masks[h][i] is the horizon at az = i*az_step_deg.
schema.case.ephem: Same fields as ephem/<id>.json (§2.3) minus meta/site_id/horizons_query: start_utc, step_minutes, count, sun{az[],el[]}, earth{az[],el[]}, sun_ang_radius_deg, earth_ang_radius_deg. Data coverage = samples 0..count-1.
schema.case.input: observer_height_m (selects masks[String(h)]); t0_utc, t1_utc: the half-open metric interval [t0, t1) (samples with t0 <= t_k < t1); t_ref_utc: reference time for sun_el_deg, sun_clearance_deg, next_* and time_to_*. In these fixtures t_ref is always exactly on a sample.
schema.case.expected: Every metric of contract §3 by its contract name. Percentages are 0..100, durations in hours, angles in degrees. next_*_utc are ISO 8601 UTC strings 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' rounded to the nearest second (all fixture events fall on whole seconds), or null. time_to_*_h are numbers or null.
schema.case.expected.gaps: Object holding the reason for each null transition: keys 'sunset' | 'sunrise' | 'earthset' | 'earthrise', value 'beyond_data'. A key is present if and only if the matching next_*_utc is null. time_to_sunset_h is null exactly when gaps.sunset is present (same for earthset).
schema.comparison: Numbers: abs(actual - expected) <= tolerance_abs. Strings and null: exact equality. gaps: deep equality.
rules_pinned_by_these_cases: sunlit / earth_in_view are true when frac >= 0.5, i.e. clear >= 0 (frac = 0.5 counts as visible).
Transition time = linear interpolation of clear between the bracketing samples, solved for clear = 0; if the earlier sample has clear exactly 0 the event is at that sample time.
next_* is the first event with time >= t_ref, searched to the end of the ephemeris coverage (may be after t1).
Longest runs count samples inside [t0, t1) only, times step_minutes/60; a run touching t1 still counts.
Horizon lookup: linear interpolation in azimuth with wrap-around (index n-1 -> index 0).
schema.derivations: Each case has a 'derivation' written by hand. Expected values were never produced by running an implementation. Builder: validation/fixtures/build_metrics_cases.py (assembles JSON only).

cases.description: Sun and Earth centres sit exactly on a flat 2.0 deg horizon at every sample.
covers: disc exactly half-cut by the horizon
cases.derivation: H = 2.0 everywhere. el_sun = el_earth = 2.0 -> clear = 0 -> x = 0 -> frac = 0.5 + (0 + asin 0)/pi = 0.5. sunlit := frac >= 0.5 -> true at all 4 samples; same for Earth. pct_sunlit = pct_earth = pct_both = 100, mean_sun_frac = 0.5*100 = 50, no dark / no-Earth runs -> 0 h. clear never changes sign -> no transitions -> all next_* null with gaps beyond_data, time_to_* null. sun_el_deg = 2.0, sun_clearance_deg = 0.0.

cases.description: Flat 0 deg horizon; Sun clearance r/2, r/2, -r, 2r.
Sun circles the sky at 5 deg over a flat 1 deg horizon for 24 h; Earth fixed at 8 deg.
covers: null + beyond_data for all four transitions
cases.derivation: H = 1.0 everywhere. clear_sun = 5 - 1 = 4 >= r for every sample (az 0..345 step 15 does not matter for a flat mask) -> frac 1, sunlit. clear_earth = 7 >= 0.95 -> in view. All pct = 100, mean_sun_frac = 100, runs 0 h. No sign change of either clearance in the whole coverage -> every next_* is null with reason beyond_data and time_to_* is null (UI: 'No sunset in data range', not 0). sun_el_deg = 5, sun_clearance_deg = 4.

cases.description: Sun sinks below a flat 0.5 deg horizon once, between 03:00 and 04:00.
covers: single sunset transition between two samples (interpolated time)
cases.derivation: H = 0.5. el = [3.5, 2.5, 1.5, 1.2998, 0.2334, -0.5] -> clear = [3, 2, 1, 0.7998, -0.2666, -1] -> frac = [1,1,1,1,0,0] (|x| >= 1). sunlit = [T,T,T,T,F,F]: pct_sunlit = 4/6*100 = 66.666..., mean_sun_frac = 66.666..., longest_dark = 2 h. Sunset between k3 and k4: f = 0.7998/(0.7998+0.2666) = 0.7998/1.0664 = 0.75 -> 03:45:00Z, time_to_sunset = 3.75 h. No false->true afterwards -> sunrise null (beyond_data). Earth at 20 deg: 100 %, no transitions. pct_both = 66.666...

cases.description: Mask is 0 except index 719 (az 359.5) = 4.0 and index 0 (az 0) = 2.0. Bodies sit in the wrap gap.
Earth rises from -5 to -2.25 deg but never reaches a flat 0 deg horizon; Sun high.
covers: Earth below horizon for the whole window
cases.derivation: H = 0. clear_earth = -5 + 0.25k (k = 0..11) -> max -2.25 <= -0.95 -> frac 0, never in view. pct_earth = 0, longest_no_earth = 12 samples * 1 h = 12, pct_both = 0. Sun at 10 deg -> 100 %, mean_sun_frac 100, longest_dark 0. No sign change for either body -> all four transitions null (beyond_data). sun_el_deg = 10, sun_clearance_deg = 10.

cases.description: Sun alternates between +1 and -1 deg (flat 0 horizon) in pattern TFFTFFFFTTFFFTTTTFTFFFFF, 30 min step, t_ref = sample 4.
covers: longest dark run (incl. a run touching the interval end)
t_ref inside the window: earlier transitions ignored
cases.derivation: H = 0, el = +1 (T) / -1 (F), |x| > 1 -> frac 1/0. Pattern TFFTFFFFTTFFFTTTTFTFFFFF: dark runs 2, 4, 3, 1, 5 (the last touches the end). longest = 5 * 0.5 h = 2.5 h. Lit samples = 9 of 24 -> pct_sunlit = mean_sun_frac = 37.5. t_ref = k4 = 02:00Z (dark): sun_el = -1, clearance = -1. T->F transitions: k0->k1 at 00:15, k3->k4 at 01:45 (both < t_ref, ignored), k9->k10 at 04:30 + 0.5*30 min = 04:45:00Z -> time_to_sunset = 2.75 h. First F->T >= t_ref: k7->k8 = 03:30 + 15 min = 03:45:00Z. Earth at 45 deg: 100 %, pct_both = 37.5.

cases.description: Sun lit TTTTFFFF, Earth in view TFFTTTTF over a flat 0 deg horizon.
covers: pct_both counts joint samples (not the product of pct_sunlit and pct_earth)
cases.derivation: H = 0. Sun el ±1 (r = 0.2666) -> sunlit TTTTFFFF: pct_sunlit = 50, mean_sun_frac = 50, longest_dark = 4 h. Earth el ±2 (r = 0.95, |x| > 1) -> TFFTTTTF: pct_earth = 5/8 = 62.5, longest_no_earth = 2 h (k1,k2). both = k0 and k3 only -> 2/8 = 25 (the product 50*62.5/100 = 31.25 would be wrong). Sunset k3->k4: f = 0.5 -> 03:30:00Z (3.5 h); no sunrise -> beyond_data. Earthset k0->k1: f = 2/4 = 0.5 -> 00:30:00Z (0.5 h); earthrise k2->k3 -> 02:30:00Z.

cases.description: Same ephemeris as observer_height_10m; mask '2' is a flat 1.0 deg horizon, mask '10' is 0.6 deg.
Same ephemeris as observer_height_2m; the 10 m mast sees a lower (0.6 deg) horizon.
10 h of data, metrics over [02:00, 06:00) only; the next sunset falls after t1 but inside the data.
covers: [t0, t1) excludes t1 and samples outside it
transitions are searched up to the end of data coverage, not only up to t1
cases.derivation: H = 0, Sun el ±1 -> sunlit over coverage = TTFFTTTTFF. Interval [02:00, 06:00) = samples k2..k5 = F,F,T,T (k6 at 06:00 is excluded): pct_sunlit = mean_sun_frac = 50, longest_dark = 2 h. t_ref = 02:00 (k2): sun_el = clearance = -1. Sunrise k3->k4 -> 03:30:00Z. Sunset k1->k2 (01:30) is before t_ref; next is k7->k8 -> 07:30:00Z, after t1 but inside coverage, so it is reported: time_to_sunset = 5.5 h ('beyond_data' means beyond the ephemeris coverage, contract §3). Earth 10 deg: 100 %, pct_both = 50.
